name: codepoint2name
doc: A dictionary that maps Unicode code points to HTML4 entity names.

name: entitydefs
doc: A dictionary mapping XHTML 1.0 entity definitions to their replacement text in ISO Latin-1.

name: html5
doc: A dictionary that maps HTML5 named character references [1] to the equivalent Unicode character(s), e.g. html5['gt;'] == '>'. Note that the trailing semicolon is included in the name (e.g. 'gt;'), however some of the names are accepted by the standard even without the semicolon: in this case the name is present with and without the ';'. See also html.unescape().

name: name2codepoint
doc: A dictionary that maps HTML4 entity names to the Unicode code points.
